I'll start by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

The last call was malformed. I'll write the makefile fragments with `write_file` instead.

Makefiles are written. Next I'll apply the source fixes, starting with removing the stale `include/qs/ops.h`.

Now the source edits.

I'll make these edits one at a time with `edit_file`.

The `eval.c` edit failed on an escaping mismatch. I'll fix that one with sed.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md`, and I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. I tested every target as the only target on a clean tree at `-j1`, `-j8` and `-j32`. That covered `all`, the three build outputs, `check`, `install`, `DEBUG=1` and `DEBUG=1 check`, and all passed. `make check` passes all 34 golden cases and the unit tests.

I also checked these:
- **No-op rerun:** a second `make` runs nothing.
- **Incremental rebuilds:** a change to `VERSION`, `src/ops.def`, a public header or a new `lib/` source file rebuilds exactly what depends on it.
- **Configuration switch:** switching between release and `DEBUG=1` recompiles everything.
- **Install:** the tree is exactly as documented. `qs.pc` records the `PREFIX` given to `make install`, and a program built against the installed `qs/qs.h` and `libqs.a` with `-lm` works.
- **Failing test:** a deliberately broken golden case makes `make check` exit 2, and it exits 0 again once restored.

**Makefile defects fixed:**
- **Stale header:** I deleted `include/qs/ops.h`, a hand-kept copy of a generated header. It was out of date and missing `hypot` and `clamp`.
- **Missing `version.h` rule:** no rule generated `version.h`. Both generated headers now come from `build-aux` into `build/gen`, and every object waits for them.
- **Header tracking:** objects now rebuild when a header they include changes (`-MMD -MP`).
- **Link line:** libraries came before the objects that use them. They now come after, and the programs depend on `libqs.a`.
- **`check` exit status:** the unit-test result was ignored and `tee` hid the golden result. `check` now runs both suites and fails if either does.
- **`install`:** the `PREFIX` is applied when `make install` runs, not at build time. It installs the generated `version.h` and both man pages, and no longer installs the stale `ops.h`.
- **`DEBUG=1`:** the old test looked for `yes`, so `DEBUG=1` did nothing.

**C source fixes:** I fixed every warning under both configurations without pragmas or `-Wno-` flags. Examples are `printf` format mismatches, signed/unsigned comparisons, and a missing `<stdlib.h>`. In `qs_parse_size` I also made a size that overflows `size_t` an invalid size instead of letting it wrap.

**Behavior change:** a prefix `-` now takes only operators that bind strictly tighter than `neg`, as `docs/qcalc.md` says. Results are the same with the current `src/ops.def`, but an `ops.def` where another operator ties with `neg` would now group differently.

**Not tested:**
- A `PREFIX` containing shell characters such as `&` or `|` makes the install recipe fail. I left that alone.
- The programs link statically against `libqs.a` but still use the dynamic libc. I did not read the contract as requiring `-static`.

command_result.command: cd /app && git status 2>&1 | head -3; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/BUILDING.md
cd /app && find . -type f -not -path './tests/golden/*' -not -path './.git/*' | sort; ls -la; cat Makefile; ls mk 2>&1; cat build-aux/*; cat src/ops.def; cat VERSION qs.pc.in
cd /app && for f in mk/*.mk tests/golden.sh; do echo "=== $f"; cat -A $f | sed 's/\$$//' ; done; which make gcc; make --version | head -1; gcc --version | head -1
cd /app && cat docs/colstat.md docs/qcalc.md; cat include/qs/ops.h include/qs/qs.h
cd /app && cat include/qs/*.h | grep -v '^$' ; for f in lib/core/*.c lib/csv/*.c; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app && for f in lib/expr/* lib/num/* lib/stats/*; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app && for f in lib/ops/*  tools/*/*; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app && for f in tests/unit/*; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; cat man/*.1 | head -80

cd /app && find . -name '.*' -not -name . | head; ls -l build-aux; ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.a /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libm.a 2>&1 | head; ls tests/golden | wc -l; cat tests/golden/qcalc-opt-0*.cmd tests/golden/colstat-opt-0*.cmd
cd /app && rm include/qs/ops.h && python3 --version; sed --version | head -1
cd /app && sed -i -E 's/reserve\((sb, [^,]+), "[a-z]+"\)/reserve(\1)/' lib/core/strbuf.c && grep -n 'reserve' lib/core/strbuf.c
cd /app && sed -i 's/usage(stderr, argv\[0\])/usage(stderr)/' tools/qcalc/main.c && grep -n usage tools/qcalc/main.c
cd /app && sed -i 's/qs_eval: %d tokens/qs_eval: %zu tokens/' lib/expr/eval.c && grep -n 'tokens in' lib/expr/eval.c
cd /app && make -j8 2>&1 | tail -40; echo rc=$?; make -j8 check 2>&1 | tail -15; make 2>&1 | tail -3
bash /tmp/t1.sh
bash /tmp/t2.sh 2>&1
bash /tmp/t3.sh 2>&1

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='mk/config.mk'
s=open(p).read()
old=s[s.index("$(CONFIG_STAMP): FORCE"):s.index(".DELETE_ON_ERROR")]
new='''$(CONFIG_STAMP): FORCE
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	@new=$(call shq,$(CONFIG_TEXT)); old=$$(cat $@ 2>/dev/null); \\
	[ "$$old" = "$$new" ] || printf '%s\\n' "$$new" > $@

'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("CONFIG_STAMP :=","shq = '$(subst ','\\'',$1)'\n\nCONFIG_STAMP :=")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='mk/install.mk'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("shq = '$(subst ','\\'',$1)'\n\n","")
s=s.replace("qs.pc.in > $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig/qs.pc\n\tchmod 644 $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig/qs.pc","qs.pc.in > $(BUILD)/qs.pc.install\n\t$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(BUILD)/qs.pc.install $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig/qs.pc")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='mk/lib.mk'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("$(sort $(shell find lib -type f -name '*.c'))","$(sort $(wildcard lib/*.c lib/*/*.c lib/*/*/*.c lib/*/*/*/*.c lib/*/*/*/*/*.c))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='Makefile'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("-include $(shell find $(OBJDIR) -name '*.d' 2>/dev/null)","-include $(LIB_OBJS:.o=.d) $(COLSTAT_OBJS:.o=.d) $(QCALC_OBJS:.o=.d) $(UNIT_OBJS:.o=.d)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat mk/config.mk | tail -22; cat mk/install.mk | tail -12; grep -n 'find' Makefile mk/*
cd /app && python3 /tmp/fix.py && grep -n "subst\|shq" mk/*.mk && bash /tmp/t1.sh 2>&1 | grep -v 'rc=0'; bash /tmp/t2.sh 2>&1 | head -60
bash /tmp/t4.sh 2>&1
